neighbours.label: first-person 'I'/'my' in archaic or literary dialogue (Shakespeare-style: 'I pray thee', 'my servant', 'sirrah')
fire: I pray thee, hear me speak.
Say I will come with thee.
I will go before you, sirrah.
I have my bond, good sir.
I shall not go with thee.
My lord, I come at once.
I put you to the test.
quiet: I went to the store downtown.

notes: The + pole peaks on modern ' I' x14; the - pole on ' I'/' my' in old/literary text. Probes: archaic 0.05-0.68, modern first person 0.001-0.07.
